headline: Away window (Aug 13-21) stayed barely profitable — 18 round trips, +$3,403, expectancy +$189/trade (down from +$1,455 in the Aug 3-14 pre-eval) — with a single AMZN 5-leg spread unwind (-$14,956) eating most of the gains, all bull-call-spreads 0-for-4 (-$33.8k cycle), and down-capture vs SPY still broken over Aug 3-21 (2.31) though the away week itself flipped positive (up 2.03 / down 1.71).
evidence: Cycle (2026-07-27 to 2026-08-21): 42 closed round trips, +$7,030.97 realized, 30.95% win rate (13W/29L), avg win $6,083.40 vs avg loss -$2,484.59, expectancy +$167.40/trade, profit factor 1.098 — vs July cycle's -$133/trade this is a recovery but far below the Aug 3-14 pre-eval's +$1,455/trade

Away window (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-21): 18 closed trips, +$3,402.85, 33.3% win rate, expectancy +$189.05/trade, PF 1.106 — the unattended bot did not blow up but expectancy collapsed ~87% vs the pre-eval sample

Top cycle winners: PATH +$13,806.78 (bracket_take 08-04), MSFT long call +$11,645 (take 08-03), SMCI +$9,437.37 (trail 08-13), CDE +$8,244.60 (trail 08-21), AXTI +$7,632.24 (bracket_take 08-17); top losers: AMZN 5-leg option group -$14,956 (watchdog stop 08-17), PLTR -$9,940 (option stop 08-07), MSFT spread -$5,248 (stop 08-05), VRRM -$4,085.08 (decision 07-30), HL spread -$3,650 (stop 08-20)

Exit-reason economics (cycle): trail +$28,674 (5) and bracket_take +$35,197 (5) do all the earning; watchdog option 'stop' -$33,794 (4) and Claude 'decision' closes -$24,695 (23) do all the losing — decision exits are 55% of all closes and net -$1,074 each

Options vs equity (cycle): options 5 closes -$22,149 vs equity 37 closes +$29,179.97; every bull_call_spread lost (4/4, -$33,794: AMZN, PLTR, MSFT, HL) and the only option winner was the single-leg MSFT long call +$11,645

Cited-signal attribution (cycle): insider-cited entries are the worst family (13 trades, -$18,681, -$1,437/trade); news-cited (+$27,377/6) and fundamentals-cited (+$28,983/26) are the strongest; congress-cited negative (-$1,421/3)

Composite-score calibration is inverted at the top: highest quartile (score >=2.02) expectancy -$859/trade cycle and -$1,792 away; 8 of the 10 highest-composite trades lost (FTK 2.86 -$2,629, QNT 2.77 -$1,621, LFTO 2.65 -$1,634, FCEL 2.43 -$2,505...), while Q3 (1.60-1.99) earned +$2,728/trade

Conviction calibration flipped between windows: full cycle low-conviction (<0.62) beat high (+$830 vs -$283/trade), but in the away window high-conviction won (+$408 vs -$380) — sample sizes too small to conclude, flag for continued tracking

Equity curve: cycle total return +0.673% ($1,006,732.28 end), max drawdown -2.98% (peak 08-04 $1,024,971.51 to trough 08-18 $994,405.90); worst day 08-18 -$26,843.77, best day 08-19 +$19,336.32; away-week daily P&L whipsawed -$26.8k/+$19.3k/-$12.0k/+$5.8k over four sessions

Capture vs SPY (Alpaca bars): away window up_capture 2.03 / down_capture 1.71 — first window where up>down (bar passed); but Aug 3-21 overall is up 1.19 / down 2.31 — still failing, avg bot -0.84% on SPY-down days vs SPY -0.36%

Reconciliation: all 16 risk_state.json exit_times (AXTI, SOUN, AMZN, None, AMZN260918C00240000, FTK, ONDS, F, INTC, MTRN, IESC, HL, IBIT, SPCX, CDE, AVBC) have matching same-day SELL records in trades.jsonl — zero missing

Ledger integrity gap: ledger realized +$7,030.97 vs broker-implied realized +$5,965.92 (delta +$1,065.05); the two AMZN external backfill sells from the 08-17 5-leg unwind carry realized_pl=null, and one has symbol literal string "None" with exit_price -1.19 (data-quality bug in exchange-side MLEG backfill)
surprises: Bull call spreads are 0-for-4 lifetime this cycle (-$33,794) and account for more than the entire cycle's net shortfall — the options book minus one lucky MSFT long call is a pure drag, and both away-window option losses (AMZN -$14,956, HL -$3,650) were watchdog premium stops

Composite score is anti-predictive at the top: the >=2.0 quartile loses money in BOTH windows while mid-scores (1.6-2.0) are the best bucket — the signal stack over-scores junky small-caps (FTK, QNT, LFTO, FCEL)
Insider-cited entries destroyed -$18,681 over 13 trades (-$1,437 each), the single worst cited signal family — worse than congress — despite insider signals being a core thesis input

Claude discretionary 'decision' exits are 23 of 42 closes and net -$24,695; mechanical exits (trail/bracket_take/take) net +$75,516 — the model's exit judgment is subtracting value vs its own brackets

Away-week capture asymmetry finally flipped positive (up 2.03 > down 1.71) — the first sample passing the bar — but the longer Aug 3-21 window still fails badly (down-capture 2.31), so the fix is unproven

Data-quality bug found: exchange-side MLEG exit backfill wrote a SELL with symbol="None" (literal string) and exit_price=-1.19, plus a second external leg with realized_pl=null — the $1,065 ledger-vs-broker realized delta traces to these unledgered legs
